title: Retain representable Kalman gains after underflowing numerator products
observation: P=1e-300, C=1e-100 and S=1e-300 yield a representable gain of 1e-100, but the old P*C/S gives zero and loses a unit correction.
cause: Kalman gain still used direct multiply-then-divide even though the existing binary-exponent helper protects other filter ratios.
severity: incorrect arithmetic, state or evidence admission on valid/ambiguous boundary inputs
implemented_change: Use the existing product-ratio helper for the gain. Verify both signs against 100-digit Decimal arithmetic, the actual B0/B1 update and the clipped AO correction.
predicted_consequence: New constructed regressions fail on the recorded parent and pass after the repair while the existing bounded suite passes.
